item.title: A postcard arrived: ‘If you’re reading this I’m dead, and I really liked you’
item.description: “It made me laugh really hard because it was just so him,” Snape said. “It went through the mail, so everyone along the way saw a postcard that said, ‘I’m dead and I really liked you.”

item.title: ‘American Soul’ author explains how Black history shapes US cuisine
item.description: Former diplomat-turned-creator Anela Malik reflects on how Black foodways formed the backbone of the American food system.

item.title: Armed man shot and killed after entering secure perimeter of Mar-a-Lago, Secret Service says
item.description: The man, who was in his early 20s and from North Carolina, had a gas can and a shotgun, according to Anthony Guglielmi, the spokesman. He had been reported missing by his family a few days ago, and investigators believe he headed south and picked up the shotgun along the way.

item.title: Jack Hughes scores in overtime as US beats Canada for gold at the Olympics
item.description: Jack Hughes scored 1:41 into overtime and the U.S. defeated Canada 2-1 in the gold medal final at the Milan Cortina Olympics on Sunday, claiming the nation’s third men’s title at the Games and its first since the “Miracle on Ice” on 1980.

item.title: Sterling Heights police investigate alleged animal abuse case caught on doorbell camera
item.description: Police have identified the suspect and removed the dog from the residence, along with an additional dog that was taken as a precautionary measure

item.title: No. 13 Iowa tops No. 6 Michigan 62-44 behind Ava Heiden’s 24 points, moves into 2nd place in Big Ten
item.description: Ava Heiden had 24 points and 10 rebounds to help No. 13 Iowa beat sixth-ranked Michigan 62-44 on Sunday.

item.title: Clintondale school boss is in the running for job in Genesee County
item.description: At Clintondale, Kenneth Janczarek has worked to improve the district's academics, focus more attention on reading skills, settled a labor agreement with the teachers union, fortified the district's fund balance, and closed Clintondale Middle School due to declining enrollment

item.title: Michigan’s Connor Hellebuyck and Jack Hughes join Jim Craig and Mike Eruzione as US Olympic hockey champions
item.description: Go ahead and put the names Jack Hughes and Connor Hellebuyck right in the same revered place that Mike Eruzione and Jim Craig have occupied since their “ Miracle On Ice ” triumph in 1980.

item.title: Carson Cooper scores career-high 20, leads No. 15 Michigan State to 66-60 win over Ohio State
item.description: Carson Cooper scored a career-high 20 points and grabbed 11 rebounds to lead No. 15 Michigan State to a 66-60 win over Ohio State on Sunday.

item.title: Snowy New Baltimore Winterfest wraps up 3-day run with polar plunge
item.description: Crowds flock to city's lakefront downtown to enjoy festival, shops and dining
